title: RepositoryIdentity
description: Provider-neutral canonical repository identity. Branches, checkout policy, and credential selectors are not authority carried by this control.

owner.description: Repository owner or Azure DevOps organization.

project.description: Azure DevOps project, required for ADO and absent for other providers.

id.description: Provider-native repository ID retained as identity evidence, never a credential selector.

url.description: Repository HTTP(S) URL identifying the service, without credentials, query, or fragment. Required for self-hosted Gitea.

component.description: Nonempty identity component without path separators, control characters, or surrounding whitespace.
